sources.title: A Primer on Mapping Class Groups
sources.citation: Benson Farb and Dan Margalit; university-hosted Version 5.0 draft
sources.inspected_version: Full university-hosted draft, not a verified publisher-final copy. Author-hosted mcgv50.pdf retrieval returned HTTP 403.
sources.recorded_inspection: Visual inspection: printed 57 / physical 67 (marked torus), 68 / 78 (handedness and actual inverse matrices), 89–90 / 99–100 (capping), 112–113 / 122–123 (two-chain relation). Audit additionally rendered and visually inspected printed 92 (one-holed-torus exact sequence), and read annular winding at printed 53–54 and centrality. The left-twist matrices are U⁻¹,V⁻¹; the displayed proof uses consistent same-handed classes.
